title: Chernobyl dogs rapidly evolved

tellings.quote: there's a study that came out, or not even a study, an article that came out like this month, I think, about these dogs at Chernobyl that have rapidly evolved more than any other dog.

plain: Dogs living around Chernobyl, the site of a nuclear disaster, have evolved faster than any other dogs. Michels mentions this himself from an article he says came out that month, which he does not name, in an episode with a guest who says aliens taught him physics. He brings it up as an example of how radiation might drive fast change in living things.
